개최국: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
축제소개: The Trade Drinks Expo, formerly known as the International Drink Expo (I.D.E), is the ultimate beverage event. The expo has established itself as the leading industry event in the UK, particularly when it comes to maximizing beverage sales. Organized by Fortem Food and Drink Ltd, the expo showcases their expertise in the beverage industry and impresses with a unique blend of networking, education, and inspiration. It's not just about the beverages; the spotlight is also on the tools and innovations that hospitality and retail professionals can utilize to maximize their sales and enhance their ROI. The expo takes place annually in either October or November at the stunning ExCeL London, one of the UK's premier exhibition centers. Over two days, attendees have the opportunity to meet providers of the world's most innovative beverage solutions. Additionally, the expo offers specialist seminars, panel discussions led by industry leaders, and the chance to experience brand-new beverage trends firsthand. The primary focus of the expo is to introduce promising products and services from the beverage sector. Exhibitors come from various segments of the industry, ranging from breweries to spirits manufacturers and innovative beverage start-ups. The Trade Drinks Expo primarily attracts hospitality and retail professionals looking for ways to optimize their beverage sales. The event is a part of the Hospitality B2B portfolio, which is linked to other exhibitions in similar sectors, thereby creating synergies for attendees. ExCeL London, where the expo is held, is one of Europe's most modern exhibition and conference centers. It is conveniently located and easily accessible by public transport and by car. In conclusion, the Trade Drinks Expo is a must-attend for anyone active in the beverage industry and seeking the latest trends, products, and business opportunities.

The "GENUSSWELTEN"in Vienna is more than just a fair – it is an annual celebration for everyone who appreciates fine food and quality beverages. Twice a year, "Genusswelten" presents a unique combination of trade fair and public exhibition, making this culinary event appealing to gourmets and industry professionals as well as interested food lovers who want to discover, experience, and taste exquisite specialties. With carefully selected exhibitors, the fair provides an exclusive opportunity to explore both regional and international delights. From fine cheeses, freshly baked bread, and artisan pastries to rare teas, select spices, refined condiments, and exquisite wines, beers, and spirits – connoisseurs will find a feast for the senses. Direct encounters between producers and visitors foster trust and offer authentic insights into the origins, quality, and craftsmanship behind the products. A varied supporting program enhances the experience: live cooking shows reveal the art of culinary craftsmanship, interactive workshops deepen knowledge about preparation and taste, and exclusive tastings invite visitors to discover and indulge. Seasonal theme worlds add variety and give each edition its own distinctive character. GENUSSWELTEN is the meeting place for all who wish to experience food and drink with all their senses – informative, delightful, and authentic.

The "WINE & SPIRITS Ukraine", which takes place annually has established itself as one of the most significant events in the Ukrainian wine and alcohol industry. Organized by the event planner VIA Group Ltd., this fair offers a unique platform for a diverse spectrum of stakeholders in the industry – including manufacturers of wines and spirits, retailers, sommeliers, restaurateurs, importers, and traders from Ukraine and the international space alike. In the culturally and historically rich Kiev, more precisely at the International Exhibition Centre (IEC), "WINE & SPIRITS Ukraine" provides the ideal backdrop for productive business communication and networking. The IEC impresses with its modern infrastructure and its easy accessibility via various modes of transportation, ensuring effortless travel for all participants. The exhibition center combines traditional charm with modern amenities, reflecting the dynamic development of the city and ensuring that all the prerequisites for a successful event are met. The main topics of the fair revolve around wine and spirits and extend from the presentation of new products to lectures and tasting sessions. It serves as a representative stage for products and services in the field of wine and spirits production, distribution, and sales, promoting Ukrainian products as well as international brands alike. A particular highlight of the fair is the international tasting competition "Ukraine Wine & Spirits Awards", which offers a stage to wines and spirits from all over the world and honors quality and innovation in this industry. The program is complemented by the WINE&SPIRITS Congress, which gives professionals from different areas the opportunity to deepen their knowledge, discuss trends, and develop forward-looking ideas. Exhibitors, coming from various sectors of the alcoholic beverage industry, have the opportunity to present their products and services to a wide, qualified audience, primarily composed of professionals from gastronomy, retailers, and experts from the wine and spirits segment. Although "WINE & SPIRITS Ukraine" is an independent event, it takes place parallel to 'WorldFood Ukraine', one of the leading international exhibitions for food and beverages, thereby creating a synergy that makes both events a must for industry insiders. In conclusion, it can be stated that "WINE & SPIRITS Ukraine" is not just a fair but a significant event that connects business people and lovers of the wine and spirits world, expands knowledge, and thus enriches the industry in Ukraine and beyond. Located in the picturesque and lively city of Kiev, the event combines local tradition with international expertise and thereby represents a relevant date in the global calendar of the wine and spirits industry.

Expo Cerveza México is the leading trade fair in Mexico dedicated to craft and specialty beer. It offers a unique platform that brings together brewing expertise, entrepreneurship, innovation, and community. Over the years, the event has become a key reference point in both the Mexican and international beer scenes—appealing to hobby brewers, established producers, raw material suppliers, and distribution professionals alike. The event takes place at the centrally located World Trade Center (WTC) in Mexico City, known for its excellent accessibility and modern infrastructure. It is organized by Tradex Exposiciones, a seasoned company specializing in industry-focused trade shows. Expo Cerveza México is more than a product showcase; it is an active networking and knowledge-sharing forum. Its core themes include the production, commercialization, and marketing of craft and specialty beers. Exhibitors present every element of the brewing process—from high-quality raw materials such as malt, hops, and yeast, to state-of-the-art brewing systems, bottling lines, and labeling equipment. As such, the fair offers significant value to both startups entering the brewing sector and established breweries seeking to enhance their operations. A key feature of the event is the professional congress Mexicanos, Hagamos Cerveza ("Mexicans, Let’s Brew Beer"). This program combines hands-on workshops and presentations on essential brewing topics—such as water, yeast, hops, and malt—with business-oriented sessions on marketing, sales, legal frameworks, and management. The congress is complemented by the Beer Talks , which provide free access to presentations on the latest industry trends, product innovations, and technological advancements. A standout experience is offered by the tasting salon Salón de Catas , where guests can refine their sensory perception through guided tastings—an engaging opportunity for both industry professionals and beer enthusiasts. A major highlight for many breweries is the prestigious Copa Cerveza , a competition that recognizes outstanding beers across various categories and brewery sizes. Award-winning beers are clearly marked at exhibitor booths, turning the fair into a curated discovery journey for visitors. The Matchmaker program fosters targeted business connections among producers, suppliers, and distributors. It provides an ideal environment for B2B interactions in hospitality, retail, import/export, technical services, and related sectors. Expo Cerveza México is not part of an international trade fair series but rather a standalone national event with global appeal. It reflects the cultural richness of Mexico and sends a strong message of inclusion, respect, and community—regardless of origin, gender, or identity. The World Trade Center in Mexico City is easily accessible by public transportation, taxi, or car and offers modern exhibition spaces along with a range of amenities for both exhibitors and visitors. Expo Cerveza México is more than just a trade show—it is the vibrant heart of a growing beer culture that extends far beyond the borders of Mexico.

The Augsburg Whisk(e)y Salon & Spirits, typically held annually in October or November, presents a sustainable and exclusive forum for the bar and spirits culture. Founded and initiated by Dr. M. Mayer of "Messen & Ausstellungen", the event has established itself as a must-attend for all aficionados of fine spirits. The event takes place at the renowned Augsburg Congress Hall, a venue that impresses both with its architecture and its rich history. The fair distinguishes itself with a careful selection of handpicked exhibitors that change each year. Here, exclusivity, advice, and pleasure are always at the forefront. The event not only offers visitors the opportunity to engage with professionals from production, trade, and distribution but also to discover current trends, news from the bar scene, and exclusive products – from rare whisk(e)ys to gin and tonics and craft beers. While esteemed names in the spirits industry undoubtedly draw many visitors, it's also the presence of local suppliers with sustainable products and innovative ideas that captivate the audience year after year. A special highlight of the fair are the seminars and tastings on offer. These specialized events, which can be booked in advance, provide participants with deep insights into the world of spirits. For those who appreciate the enjoyment of cigars, a smoking lounge is available. Additionally, visitors can look forward to a diverse range of food trucks, setting culinary highlights. Both attractions are located outdoors on the spacious terrace of the Congress Hall. Another annual highlight is the interactive special exhibition, always full of surprises. In conclusion, the Augsburg Whisk(e)y Salon & Spirits is a unique experience – a place where spirit enthusiasts gather to discover new things, exchange ideas, and savor together.

전시회명: JFEX JAPAN INT’L FOOD & BEVERAGE EXPO
축제소개: The "JFEX Summer JAPAN INT'L FOOD & BEVERAGE EXPO", an international fair in Tokyo, is dedicated to showcasing food and beverages from around the world. "JFEX", short for "Japan Food Expo", reflects the event's focus on the food industry. This trade fair takes place twice a year at Tokyo Big Sight, one of Japan's leading exhibition centers. It is organized by RX Japan Ltd., a company known for its extensive experience and expertise in organizing international exhibitions. JFEX is divided into four main areas: JFEX FOOD, focusing on frozen foods, ready-to-eat meals, agricultural and seafood products, confectionery, and spices; JFEX WINE and SPIRITS, presenting alcoholic beverages such as wine, beer, whisky, liqueurs, sake, and shochu; JFEX MEAT and DAIRY, specializing in meat and dairy products; and JFEX PREMIUM, showcasing luxury food items, confectionery, agricultural products, and both alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. The fair offers an excellent platform for exploring the diversity and innovations of the global food and beverage industry, particularly from Japan. It provides insights into current trends and serves as a meeting point for business contacts and networking. Exhibitors range from food and beverage manufacturers to agricultural companies and providers of packaging and processing technologies. The main visitors include professionals from the food industry, retailers and wholesalers, importers, exporters, and restaurateurs. JFEX is not only a central meeting point for professionals but also reflects the local culture and gastronomy. Tokyo, the venue, is known for its culinary diversity and its role as a trade and industrial center. As part of a global series of fairs representing the food and beverage industry, JFEX plays a significant role in the sector. Tokyo Big Sight in Tokyo stands out for its strategically advantageous location and excellent accessibility. It is an ideal place for international exhibitions and boasts an excellent infrastructure that is easily accessible by both public transport and car, facilitating participation for international visitors and exhibitors.

ProWine in Mumbai is an annual trade fair that has established itself as a key platform for the wine and spirits industry in India. Since its debut in 2021, it has become an important meeting point for professionals from the beverage trade, gastronomy, hospitality, as well as for sommeliers, wine clubs, and importers. The event is exclusively open to trade visitors and offers a carefully curated environment for business development, education, and sensory experiences. As part of the renowned ProWein trade fair series—with locations in Düsseldorf, Shanghai, Hong Kong, São Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo—ProWine Mumbai benefits from a globally proven concept tailored to the specific needs of the Indian market. It is organized by Messe Düsseldorf India Pvt. Ltd. in collaboration with All Things Nice, a leading company in wine events and culture in India. Hosted at the Jio World Convention Centre (JWCC), the event underscores its commitment to quality and professionalism. This state-of-the-art venue, located in the heart of Mumbai, ranks among the most advanced event spaces in the country and offers ideal conditions for a premium trade fair. Mumbai’s proximity to the emerging wine region of Nashik, the craft spirits hub of Goa, and the major port of Nhava Sheva further enhances its role as a key logistics center for the import and distribution of wines and spirits. ProWine Mumbai combines an international exhibition with a high-quality supporting program and targeted tasting experiences. The “Tasting Room” provides an exclusive setting for professional tastings and fosters dialogue on flavors, quality, and industry trends. A particular highlight is the “Wine and Food Pairing” program, which presents creative combinations of wine and Indian cuisine—from fine dining to authentic street food. At the ProWine Mumbai Forum, national and international industry experts share insights through lectures, panel discussions, and masterclasses. Topics include current developments, global market trends, and local challenges. Alongside wine, spirits and craft beer are gaining increasing importance, broadening the product range of the fair. This offering is further complemented by modern wine technologies, distribution solutions, branding strategies, and concepts for gastronomy and bar operations. With its depth of content, international orientation, and strategic integration into the Indian market, ProWine Mumbai represents the entire value chain of the industry—placing a strong focus on taste, education, and business growth.

The " Finest Spirits Festival " in Munich is an annual, prestigious event organized by Meininger Verlag GmbH, specializing in the world of high-quality spirits. It is held at the Zenith Cultural Hall, which impresses not only with its stunning architecture but also with its accessibility—making it an ideal venue for a festival of this magnitude. Finest Spirits serves as a platform for a wide range of premium spirits, including whisky, gin, rum, tequila, fruit brandy, and cognac. Both established manufacturers and innovative startups showcase their latest creations and products here. The festival provides a unique opportunity for producers, traders, and importers from around the world to present their exclusive spirits to an enthusiastic audience. A key aspect of the fair is education. Through the offered masterclasses and sensory seminars, both newcomers and experienced spirit connoisseurs can gain in-depth insights into the production and tasting of various spirits. These educational offerings make the festival a valuable experience hub where visitors can expand their knowledge and sharpen their senses. With about 4,500 visitors annually, the event attracts a diverse audience, including professionals from the gastronomy and trade sectors as well as passionate bartenders and spirit enthusiasts. Finest Spirits is not just a festival, but also a cultural event that celebrates the tradition and innovation of the spirits industry, deeply rooted in Munich's and Germany's cultural landscapes. Whether for direct purchase or pre-ordering, the fair offers the chance to discover new favorite spirits and directly engage with the producers. In conclusion, the "Finest Spirits Festival" stands out not only for its diverse offerings but also for its excellent location in the Zenith Cultural Hall, which is easily accessible by public transport. This makes it a must-visit for anyone wanting to experience the fascinating world of fine spirits.

The HANSE SPIRIT is an annual spirits fair that has been held in Hamburg , a city known as the 'Gateway to the World,' since its inception in 2011. This consumer trade show, typically taking place towards the end of January, has become a significant meeting point for spirits enthusiasts, retailers, as well as professionals from the catering and hospitality industries. The main focus of HANSE SPIRIT is on the presentation and tasting of high-quality spirits. Visitors have the opportunity to stroll from booth to booth, sampling and purchasing a variety of fine spirits such as whiskey, rum, cognac, fruit brandies, gin, liqueurs, and other specialties. The fair offers not just a chance to discover and acquire exquisite products, but also the opportunity to participate in guided tastings and receive advice from experts. Another highlight of HANSE SPIRIT is the seminars offered, where visitors can delve deeper into the subject matter and expand their knowledge about different spirits. These seminars also provide a platform for exchanging experiences and expertise. The trade fair takes place in the Hamburg Exhibition Center, which is characterized by its modern architecture and central location in Hamburg. This venue provides the ideal setting for the sophisticated and diverse offerings of Hanse Spirit. Thus, the fair is not just a place to discover exquisite spirits, but also a platform for networking and establishing business relationships in the industry. In summary, HANSE SPIRIT is a fair that annually brings together spirit-loving consumers, professionals, and industry experts, immersing them in the world of fine spirits and offering an unforgettable experience in the realm of spirits.

The WEIN & GENUSS Linz is an annual event held at the Design Center Linz, marking the beginning of the wine year in Austria. Organized by Vinaria, Austria's leading wine magazine published by LWmedia GmbH & Co. KG, the fair has become an important meeting place for wine enthusiasts and connoisseurs of fine dining over the years. The fair focuses on the finest wines and vintners, from all Austrian wine regions as well as international vineyards. WEIN & GENUSS Linz offers a unique platform where visitors can taste exquisite wines and discover a variety of high-quality foods. From delicious regional products to international specialties, the fair presents a wide range of culinary experiences. Visitors can taste not only new wine vintages but also beer, cider, and bacon from Upper Austria, gourmet meatloaf, wild products from the Waldviertel, fresh crêpes, Kaiserschmarren with apricot compote, and various fine spirits. Another highlight of the fair is the commented Masterclasses, specially offered in the new studio of the Design Center Linz for those interested. These provide an excellent opportunity to deepen one's knowledge and learn directly from experts. The Design Center Linz, as the venue, emphasizes the exclusivity of this event with its modern architecture and flexible room concepts. The available parking options, both outdoor and in the underground garage at the fair site, ensure convenient access for visitors. WEIN & GENUSS Linz stands out for its unique combination of high-quality products, expert presentations, and a welcoming atmosphere. It is not just a fair, but a festival of the senses, becoming a memorable experience for wine and gourmet lovers each year.

The "Beer & Beverage Technologies Expo" (BBTech Expo) is a trade fair dedicated to technologies and innovations in the beer and beverage industry. It takes place annually at the Rimini Expo Centre in Rimini, Italy, and is organized by the Italian Exhibition Group SpA (IEG). As a key industry gathering, the event provides a comprehensive platform for experts, producers, and trade visitors from around the world to explore the latest developments in beverage production and processing. The BBTech Expo focuses on modern processing technologies, filling systems, raw materials, packaging solutions, as well as specialized equipment and services tailored to the needs of the beer and beverage industry. Leading companies showcase innovative machinery, sustainable production methods, and groundbreaking solutions that significantly influence the market. The fair is particularly relevant for breweries, beverage manufacturers, suppliers, and distribution companies, offering a valuable opportunity to network with industry experts and establish new business connections. A special highlight of the event is the Beer&Tech Arena, which bridges beer culture and technological innovation. In collaboration with universities, consortia, and industry associations, it hosts seminars, workshops, and expert discussions that provide in-depth insights into emerging trends and research findings. The BBTech Expo attracts a diverse audience, including brewers, beverage technologists, machine builders, raw material suppliers, packaging specialists, as well as sales and marketing professionals. It appeals to both established market players and startups looking to shape the industry's future. Additionally, the fair is closely linked with SIGEP – The Dolce World Expo, a prestigious food industry event held concurrently in Rimini. The city of Rimini, located on the Italian Adriatic coast, offers a modern exhibition center with excellent infrastructure and accessibility. The Rimini Expo Centre is well connected to the international airport, high-speed rail network, and major highways, ensuring convenient access for visitors from across Europe and beyond. In addition to attending the trade fair, visitors can explore Rimini's historic old town, rich in cultural landmarks and renowned for its legendary Italian hospitality. The BBTech Expo is not just a trade fair but a must-attend event for those eager to actively shape the future of the beverage industry.

The ProWine in Düsseldorf is recognized as the leading international trade fair for the wine and spirits industry, providing an essential platform for professional visitors from retail, wholesale, gastronomy, hotel industry, and the processing industry. Since its inception in 1994, it has evolved into an annual highlight in March, organized by Messe Düsseldorf GmbH. The fair impresses with its comprehensive presentation of the global market, bringing together experts and leading figures from the industry. Visitors have the opportunity to discover a wide range of products and services including classic wines, sparkling wines, exotic spirits, mineral water, gastronomy accessories, IT solutions, specialized literature, and more. Additionally, craft beer, craft spirits, and cider are gaining importance and enriching the selection. A focal point is the presentation of internationally renowned wineries and their high-quality products from various grape varieties. Products from organic farming are also showcased, highlighting the growing significance of sustainable cultivation methods. Beyond the exhibition, ProWein serves as a forum for knowledge exchange and inspiration. Theme-specific tastings, diverse lectures, discussion rounds, and culinary events enhance the trade fair experience. These activities offer professional visitors unique insights and learning opportunities, both at the stands and in the ProWein Forum and in the tasting zone Munus Vini. Messe Düsseldorf, with its modern infrastructure and central location, provides an ideal base for this international event. The halls are specifically designed to facilitate exchange and networking between exhibitors and professional visitors, while ensuring a pleasant and efficient fair experience. In summary, ProWein is an indispensable event for professionals in the wine and spirits industry aiming for international success. It offers a comprehensive overview of current trends and innovations, valuable networking opportunities, and a versatile program for further education and inspiration.

The "Beer Warsaw Expo" is a trade fair dedicated to the world of brewing products. It takes place annually at the Ptak Warsaw Expo in Nadarzyn, a renowned exhibition center near Warsaw. The fair is organized by Ptak Warsaw Expo Sp. z o.o., which is committed to presenting a wide range of products and services from the brewing industry. The fair offers a platform where everything related to beer brewing – from raw materials to finished products – is showcased. Companies and professionals have the opportunity to establish their brands, present their successes, and exchange ideas about the latest trends and technologies. The main themes of the fair include brewing technologies, new beer varieties, packaging solutions, and marketing strategies. The Beer Warsaw Expo presents a variety of products and services focused on the brewing industry. The main categories include brewery equipment and technology, such as brewing kettles, fermentation tanks, cooling systems, filling and packaging machines, as well as cleaning and sterilization technologies. Ingredients and raw materials such as malt, hops, yeast, and various additives are also showcased. Packaging solutions like bottles, cans, labeling systems, and packaging materials are part of the offer. Additionally, emphasis is placed on software and technology for brewery management, quality control, and laboratory equipment for analysis and quality assurance of beer to ensure consistency and high standards. Overall, the Beer Warsaw Expo provides a comprehensive overview of current trends, innovations, and services in the brewing industry, thus establishing itself as a central meeting point for all industry players. The Beer Warsaw Expo gains importance not only locally but also nationally, as it attracts Polish and international exhibitors and visitors. It reflects the dynamic beer culture of the country and promotes the exchange of ideas and business contacts. Highlights of the fair include various lectures and an industry conference, conducted by experienced practitioners and industry experts. The exhibitors come from various areas of the brewing industry, including manufacturers of brewery equipment, suppliers of raw materials, and specialists in marketing and sales. The main target group of the fair includes professionals from the brewing industry, gastronomy, as well as beer enthusiasts and experts looking for new trends and products. In conclusion, the Ptak Warsaw Expo in Nadarzyn impresses not only with its modern facilities and considerable size but also with its good accessibility. It creates an ideal environment for networking and business deals, making the Beer Warsaw Expo an indispensable event for everyone in the brewing industry.

DRINKTECH, an integral part of ProPak Vietnam and a trade fair dedicated exclusively to technologies, equipment, and solutions for the beverage industry, has established itself as a significant business platform since its inception in 2024. It successfully connects global suppliers with local and regional beverage providers in Vietnam and beyond. Its annual occurrence emphasizes its crucial role and commitment to presenting the industry with continuously innovative solutions. The fair is organized by Informa Markets Vietnam in cooperation with SES Vietnam Exhibition Services Co., Ltd. This partnership ensures professional management and offers a wide range of themes and focal points. Visitors can look forward to a variety of products and services ranging from modern technologies in beverage production to packaging solutions and quality control systems. A special highlight of DRINKTECH is the opportunity for exhibitors to present their innovations directly. This offers visitors the chance to experience the latest trends and technologies up close. The beer tasting corner is particularly noteworthy, not only exciting visitors but also facilitating informal exchanges between experts and enthusiasts. The event is further complemented by a comprehensive conference program that brings together renowned speakers from around the world to discuss current issues and challenges in the beverage industry. The conferences and workshops provide deep insights and present solutions. The Saigon Exhibition & Convention Center (SECC) in Ho Chi Minh City, known for its modern infrastructure and convenient location, serves as the venue. It offers ideal conditions for DRINKTECH and eases the arrival for both national and international participants. With its capacity and facilities, the SECC supports an effective presentation of the exhibitors and their products. In summary, DRINKTECH within ProPak Vietnam represents a unique platform for professionals in the beverage industry to learn about the latest technologies and market trends, establish business contacts, and further their education. Its significance as a meeting point for the global and regional beverage industry is enhanced by a versatile exhibition and conference offer, as well as its strategic position in the heart of Southeast Asia.

개최국: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
축제소개: The Pub Show in London is the only event in the UK dedicated exclusively to the pub sector. Organized by the prestigious Montgomery Group, it takes place annually at ExCeL London, one of the leading international exhibition and conference centers. ExCeL London is distinguished by its excellent accessibility and modern infrastructure, making it the ideal meeting place for exhibitors and visitors from around the world to conduct business and exchange knowledge. Serving as a central forum for trends, innovations, and business opportunities in the pub sector, the fair provides a platform for discussions and sessions on current developments and influences in the industry. Experts and industry leaders share their expertise and insights to give participants a deeper understanding of the sector. A special highlight is the designer beer garden, which offers a relaxed atmosphere for networking. Here, attendees can experience and test the latest products. The fair also serves as a platform for introducing new products and services relevant to the pub sector, from beverages and food to equipment and technology. Moreover, "The Pub Show" facilitates the generation of new business opportunities and the maintenance of existing relationships. Its integration into the Food, Drink & Hospitality Week enhances the event's reach and influence by creating synergies with related industries and presenting a broader range of products and services. With its focus on innovation and progress, the fair is an indispensable opportunity for industry professionals to network, learn, and grow. As an annual event, it is a unique platform for anyone involved in or interested in the pub sector, significantly contributing to shaping the industry's future.

The "Seoul Bar & Spirit Show", established in 2021, is the only expo in Korea that exclusively specializes in high-quality spirits and bar culture. Known by the acronym SBSS, this annual event takes place in the prestigious COEX Convention and Exhibition Center in Seoul, organized by the experienced Exporum. As a platform for the latest trends and innovations in the spirits industry, SBSS attracts a wide audience – from industry experts and bar enthusiasts to professional visitors from various fields. The expo presents a variety of spirits, including whisky, cognac, rum, gin, vodka, and tequila, complemented by liqueurs, cocktails, beer, wine, and traditional Korean spirits. Additionally, gourmet foods as well as household appliances and equipment are showcased. This expo offers a unique opportunity for networking among industry experts who share a passion for bars and their unique atmosphere. It is also an important source of expertise and fosters the exchange of new trends. A highlight of the expo is the "WORLD COCKTAIL BATTLE", a competition that spotlights creative bartenders and their innovative cocktail creations. The exhibitors at the SBSS come from various sectors, including spirit producers, distributors, restaurateurs, and suppliers of bar equipment. Although the expo is primarily intended for professional visitors from these sectors, it also attracts a wide audience of bar enthusiasts and spirit lovers. The Seoul Bar & Spirit Show is closely connected to the dynamic, rapidly evolving bar culture of Korea and reflects the influence of Seoul as a vibrant center for gastronomy and nightlife. In conclusion, it is worth emphasizing that the COEX Convention and Exhibition Center in Seoul not only impresses with its central location but also with its excellent accessibility. It is a hub for cultural and business events in the city and offers modern infrastructure, making the Seoul Bar & Spirit Show an unforgettable event. The first day of the trade fair is reserved exclusively to professional visitors.

The USA Trade Tasting (USATT) is an annual trade fair held in Chicago, dedicated entirely to the world of alcoholic beverages and serving as a central meeting point for industry professionals. Founded by the renowned Beverage Trade Network—an internationally recognized supporter of small and medium-sized importers and distributors—USATT has become a key platform for connecting international brands with the U.S. market. The event is exclusively open to trade visitors, including retailers, distributors, bartenders, sommeliers, wholesalers, and importers. It offers a specialized opportunity to discover new products, gain practical industry insights, and establish targeted business connections. The focus lies on solutions for market entry and distribution in the United States, complemented by in-depth knowledge of market trends, legal frameworks, and developments in sustainability, digitalization, and brand strategy. A core component of the event is the ABID Conference (Alcohol Beverage Importers & Distributors Conference), where leading experts address current topics such as logistics, e-commerce, import regulations, and storytelling in brand building. Through masterclasses and expert presentations, participants receive actionable insights on how to successfully position their brands in the highly competitive U.S. market. Practical topics such as compliance, packaging innovations, and social media strategies are also explored. While discovering new products remains a priority, the event equally emphasizes the development of long-term business partnerships. The UK counterpart to USATT is the UK Trade Tasting, held annually in London. The venue for the USATT is the modern Morgan MFG, a former industrial space in the heart of Chicago. With its urban atmosphere and state-of-the-art facilities, it provides the ideal setting for tastings, networking, and presentations. Visitors can explore a wide variety of products across wine, beer, spirits, and non-alcoholic beverages—many of which are being introduced to the U.S. market for the first time. More than just a trade fair, USATT is a strategic launchpad for brands looking to establish or expand their presence in the U.S. With its sharp focus, expert curation, and global relevance, it stands out as one of the few events worldwide that is at once practical, distinctive, and highly specialized—a must-attend for anyone committed to shaping the future of the beverage trade.

The "Barcelona Beer Festival" (BBF) is the most significant trade fair and the largest craft beer festival in Southern Europe. As the heart of the international craft beer scene, it transforms the Catalan metropolis into the center of beer culture for three days. Organized by Beer Events, S.L., the BBF takes place annually at Fira de Barcelona, attracting brewers, traders, restaurateurs, and beer enthusiasts from around the world. At its core, the festival celebrates artisanal brewing, showcasing an impressive variety of creative beers with innovative flavors and aromas. Visitors have the opportunity to sample hundreds of beers presented by international, national, and local breweries. Experienced "Beer Informers" are on hand to offer guidance and help guests find the perfect beer to suit their taste preferences. Beyond enjoyment, the BBF fosters professional exchange within the industry. The parallel event, InnBrew, provides a platform for brewery and gastronomy professionals to discuss emerging trends, new technologies, and market strategies. Another highlight is the Barcelona Beer Challenge, one of Europe's most prestigious beer competitions, recognizing the best beers of the past year. Additionally, the Gastro Show emphasizes the close connection between craft beer and gastronomy, offering innovative food pairings and culinary experiences. Barcelona, as a vibrant metropolis with a deeply rooted culinary and artisanal beer culture, is the ideal host for this unique event. The city embodies creativity, indulgence, and innovation—values that the BBF also represents. Fira de Barcelona, one of Europe’s leading exhibition and convention centers, provides the perfect infrastructure and excellent transport connections. The Barcelona Beer Festival is more than just a trade fair—it is a movement, a gathering place for everyone passionate about the art of craft beer and its evolution. Whether brewer, restaurateur, or beer enthusiast, people come together to discover, learn, and enjoy. Year after year, the BBF sets new standards, demonstrating the endless diversity of the craft beer world.

KIBEX – Korea International Beer Expo is South Korea’s leading trade fair for the beer and brewing industry and one of the most important industry gatherings in the Asian brewing landscape. Once a year, the global beer community meets at the renowned COEX Convention and Exhibition Center in the heart of Seoul to exchange insights on the latest developments, trends, and technological innovations. The event is organized by the Global MICE Experts Group (GMEG) – a seasoned specialist in international business events, with a strong focus on professional excellence and strategic networking. What sets KIBEX apart is its clearly defined, industry-specific focus: The expo uniquely combines market developments, technical innovations in brewing, evolving consumer trends, and global perspectives. From new raw materials and state-of-the-art brewing equipment to digital process solutions, safety and quality standards, and export strategies – KIBEX offers a comprehensive platform for expertise, product innovation, and forward-thinking solutions across the entire beer value chain. A key highlight of the event is KIBCON – Korea International Beer Conference, an international forum featuring expert presentations and panel discussions on market analysis, innovation strategies, and global challenges facing the brewing industry. Complementing the expo is the prestigious KIBA – Korea International Beer Award, a global competition in which beers from around the world are evaluated by an international panel of experts – a mark of quality with significant impact in the international market. KIBEX attracts a diverse professional audience, including brewers, beverage manufacturers, suppliers, distributors, importers, equipment providers, and hospitality professionals. Exhibitors represent key sectors such as beer production, brewing technology, packaging, logistics, raw materials, and specialized services. This makes KIBEX a valuable hub for business development, product showcasing, and exploring new market opportunities. One of the most appreciated features is the Business Matching Program, which facilitates targeted international partnerships between producers, distributors, and buyers. In addition, interactive programs such as the “Brew It Yourself” Academy for homebrewers, guided tours, and live demonstrations create a hands-on, experience-oriented atmosphere that combines knowledge-sharing with engaging networking opportunities. The venue – the COEX Convention and Exhibition Center in Gangnam, Seoul – is one of Asia’s most advanced exhibition centers, offering excellent infrastructure and connectivity. With direct access to the city’s subway network, international hotels, shopping malls, and a wide range of dining options, COEX provides ideal conditions for a successful trade show visit in one of Asia’s most dynamic metropolitan cities.

DRINK SEOUL is South Korea’s premier trade fair for the national and international beverage industry. Held annually at the renowned COEX Convention and Exhibition Center in Seoul – one of Asia’s most advanced venues for exhibitions and events – the show is organized by the Global MICE Experts Group (GMEG), a seasoned provider of international B2B trade events with a strong focus on networking platforms. As a central industry meeting point for manufacturers, distributors, buyers, and professionals from the beverage, food, and hospitality sectors, DRINK SEOUL offers a high-caliber platform to showcase and discover the latest trends, technologies, and products. Exhibitors range from breweries, wineries, and spirits producers to makers of traditional Korean beverages, as well as suppliers of raw materials, machinery, equipment, franchise concepts, and retail technologies. The fair also features MD products, by-products, and specialized services such as training and consulting. A particular emphasis is placed on the diverse and innovative world of beverages – from craft beer and premium spirits to trending non-alcoholic drinks – and on the fusion of traditional brewing and distilling craftsmanship with forward-thinking product design. DRINK SEOUL positions itself not only as a trade fair, but also as a source of inspiration, a trend monitor, and a professional development hub. Masterclasses, seminars, and tasting sessions covering categories such as wine, sake, mead, and soju provide deep insights into the history, production methods, and sensory characteristics of these drinks. International competitions and cultural showcases – including those held in parallel with the Korea International Beer Expo (KIBEX) – make the event an immersive experience, highlighting Korea’s cultural identity as a country rich in tradition yet open to innovation. The combination of business matching, networking events, and knowledge-sharing opportunities makes DRINK SEOUL especially valuable for decision-makers in sales, retail, gastronomy, hospitality, as well as importers, export agencies, and franchise providers. DRINK SEOUL offers a prominent stage for both local start-ups and global brands to position themselves in the dynamic South Korean market and build sustainable partnerships. The venue – COEX in Seoul’s Gangnam district – is easily accessible via several subway lines and ideally situated amidst hotels, restaurants, and shopping areas, making it convenient for both domestic and international visitors. Anyone who doesn’t want to miss the next big development in the beverage industry can’t afford to overlook DRINK SEOUL.

Vyno Dienos (Wine Days) is the largest and most prestigious wine fair in the Baltic region. Held annually at LITEXPO, the Lithuanian Exhibition and Congress Centre in Vilnius—the capital of Lithuania—the event has, since its inception in 2005, become a major meeting point for industry professionals and wine enthusiasts aged 20 and above. It has gained international recognition and is organized by Vyno Klubas, a dedicated Lithuanian organization committed to promoting wine knowledge and culture, widely regarded as a leading force in the industry. More than just a showcase for global wine trends, Vyno Dienos plays a key role in supporting Lithuania’s young but rapidly growing wine scene. It brings together wine lovers, winemakers, importers, distributors, and experts from both Lithuania and abroad, offering a unique platform for professional exchange, product discovery, and sensory experiences. The event primarily focuses on European wines, complemented by a curated selection of sparkling wines, mead, and craft beers. A standout feature of the fair is its guided tastings, where attendees can interact directly with producers and sample rare or newly released wines. The tasting experience is enriched by a thoughtfully selected range of gourmet foods and delicacies that pair perfectly with the wines on offer. The event also features a diverse educational program, including workshops, seminars, and expert-led lectures—some geared toward sommelier training—designed to deepen wine knowledge at an advanced level. In addition, the fair showcases wine accessories and cutting-edge technologies related to wine production and storage. Visitors also gain insights into wine tourism opportunities and destinations, appealing to both private travelers and tour operators. Networking events further encourage direct connections between producers, trade professionals, and retailers, creating fertile ground for new collaborations. With its blend of international scope, regional focus, high-quality educational content, and immersive tasting experiences, Vyno Dienos stands out as a one-of-a-kind wine fair—a must-attend annual event for industry experts and passionate wine lovers alike. Admission to the fair is strictly permitted only to persons aged 20 and over.

개최장소(베뉴): Diamond Island Convention and Exhibition Center
축제소개: FoodEx Cambodia (Food Exhibition Cambodia) is the leading trade fair for the food and beverage industry in Cambodia. Held annually at the Diamond Island Convention and Exhibition Center (DIECC) in Phnom Penh, the event is organized by VEAS Co., Ltd. It is specifically designed for professionals from the retail, manufacturing, hospitality, and food service sectors who are seeking insights into the latest trends, technologies, and products in food, packaging, and processing. What sets FoodEx Cambodia apart is its clear focus on the needs of the Southeast Asian market, combined with an international outlook. The exhibition showcases a wide range of food products – from fresh fruits and vegetables, meat and poultry, and seafood to dairy products, delicacies, beverages, dietary supplements, and organic foods. This diverse offering is complemented by state-of-the-art food processing technologies, specialized machinery, innovative packaging solutions, as well as refrigeration and storage systems. Equipment for restaurants, hotels, and large-scale kitchens is also on display, making the fair a comprehensive platform that covers the entire value chain of the industry. The event reflects Cambodia’s economic growth and the increasing professionalization of its food and hospitality sectors. At the same time, it serves as an international hub for innovation and business development in a region marked by rising consumer awareness. Exhibitors from around the world – including food producers, machinery manufacturers, and packaging technology providers – connect with a highly engaged audience of importers, wholesalers, retail chains, hospitality professionals, investors, and key industry decision-makers. A core feature of the fair is its supporting program of conferences and seminars, where renowned industry experts share insights into current market developments, technological innovations, and sustainable solutions. Networking events and B2B matchmaking sessions add further value, establishing FoodEx Cambodia as a must-attend event on the industry calendar. The venue – the Diamond Island Convention and Exhibition Center – is centrally located on Koh Pich (Diamond Island) in Phnom Penh. Thanks to its convenient access via the international airport, major roads, and public transport, the exhibition center is easily reachable. With its modern infrastructure, spacious exhibition halls, and proximity to hotels and restaurants, the DIECC provides the ideal setting for an event of this scale.

The " Inter Food EXPO ", held annually at the Karen Demirchyan-Komplex in Yerevan, Armenia, is an international trade fair for the food industry. Organized by the Logos Expo Center, it has established itself as an indispensable platform for industry leaders and representatives from both wholesale and retail sectors. Armenia's geographical position, increasingly important in global food production and distribution, adds significant relevance to the fair. The aim of the Inter Food EXPO is to showcase a wide range of products and services. These include meat and dairy products, non-alcoholic beverages, mineral water, spirits, tobacco products, confectioneries, and ice cream. The fair also presents the latest technologies in food production and packaging, making it an essential gathering for professionals in the field. The fair not only offers insights into innovations and new products but also serves as an educational platform. Seminars and round-table discussions on current issues and future perspectives of the food industry are held, emphasizing its role as a place for learning and professional exchange. Annually, the fair attracts a diverse array of industry representatives, including manufacturers, suppliers, wholesalers, and retailers. It is also a magnet for restaurateurs and governmental regulatory bodies, highlighting the variety of participants and the broad interest it generates. The Karen Demirchyan-Komplex, with its modern facilities and convenient access, is an ideal venue. Moreover, Yerevan's rich cultural and historical context provides additional incentives for international visitors to attend the fair and take the opportunity to explore Armenia.
